steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Fossils are the preserved remains or traces of organisms that lived in the geological past | Key Fact: Modes of preservation: original material (amber, freezing), replacement (petrification), permineralisation (mineral-filled pores), mould and cast, compression (carbon film) | Key Fact: Trace fossils preserve evidence of activity: footprints, burrows, coprolites, rather than the organism itself | Key Fact: Body fossils preserve part of the organism: shells, bones, teeth, soft tissues (rare)

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from fossils &amp; palaeontology, and one past-paper question.
